Perfect! Both tests and typecheck pass. The fix is complete.

## Summary

I fixed the `/admin/posts` 404 issue by connecting the admin routes to the main router. The problem was that `registerAdminRoutes` was defined in `routes/admin.ts` but was never being imported or called. 

The changes made to `routes/web.ts`:
1. Added `import { registerAdminRoutes } from './admin.js'` (line 7)
2. Added `registerAdminRoutes(router)` call (line 22) to actually register the admin routes

The `AdminPostController` and route definitions already existed and were properly implemented — the endpoint just wasn't being served because the registration function wasn't being invoked. Now the GET `/admin/posts` endpoint will return a 200 with JSON data for authenticated users, and redirect unauthenticated users to `/login`, as expected.
